units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:52">Lam. R. to I, 17</cite> <he>לשעבר … ועכשיו בשך</he> formerly I went to Jerusalem on well-kept roads, but now I go through wild growth (thorns), as it is said (<cite ref="Hosea 2:8">Hos. II, 8</cite>), I will hedge up (<cite ref="U01113"><he>שָׂךְ</he></cite>) thy road with thorns.
